items.title: IVZ Q3 deep dive: margin expansion driven by global inflows and expense discipline
items.summary: Asset management firm Invesco (NYSE:IVZ) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with sales up 16.5% year on year to $1.38 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.72 per share was 2.6% below analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: The top 5 analyst questions from Invesco’s Q3 earnings call
items.summary: Invesco’s third quarter results were defined by strong global inflows and notable operating margin expansion, offset by a modest shortfall in adjusted earnings per share compared to analyst expectations. Management pointed to the firm’s broad-based asset growth, especially outside the U.S., as a key factor behind revenue gains.
